data: What is the identification rate when Beta is 0.2?

The question asks for the identification rate when Beta is 0.2. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the evolution of the identification rate as a function of Alpha and Beta. The right subfigure represents the relationship between Identification rate (%) and Beta.

Looking at the right subfigure, we can see a curve that starts at approximately 40% on the y-axis and increases as Beta increases. At Beta = 0.2, the curve intersects the y-axis at approximately 50%. Therefore, the identification rate when Beta is 0.2 is around 50%.
